JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=e.ID
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5

    FROM Examination e2
    JOIN Laboratory l2 ON l2.ID=e2.ID
    WHERE l2.CRE < 1.5
  );

FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.GPT < 60
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
ORDER BY MAX(l.GPT) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT e.Thrombosis, e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM Examination AS e
GROUP BY e.Thrombosis, e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 20;
SELECT Thrombosis, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patients FROM Examination GROUP BY Thrombosis ORDER BY Thrombosis;

SELECT e.Thrombosis, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patients, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.C4 > 10 THEN e.ID END) AS c4_normal FROM Examination e LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=e.ID GROUP BY e.Thrombosis ORDER BY e.Thrombosis;
SELECT e.ID, e.Thrombosis, e.Diagnosis, MAX(l.C4) AS max_c4 FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=e.ID GROUP BY e.ID, e.Thrombosis, e.Diagnosis HAVING max_c4 > 10 LIMIT 20;
